Name: Eugene - Seasonal Outfits
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
So, I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7002]Eugene[/url] (if you couldn't tell from his [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]English translation[/url]), but as someone who uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cuter Characters[/url], he never quite matched the rest of my town. Even in vanilla he stood out after the 1.6 update, as he never got winter outfits. So, for the sake of having a unified look, I started working on and off on this - and this is the result of my attempt to give him an SCC-ish revamp!
[line]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=3][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped Portraits & Sprites:[/b] Portraits done from scratch by yours truly to give him a more vanilla-ish look while keeping the original vibe, as well as redrawn sprites that are closer to SCC's style but still keep the original silhouette!
[*][b]Seasonal Outfits[/b], of course! By default gives him one outfit per season, as well as one for the Flower Dance and another for Spirit's Eve [size=2](they are pretty simple and similar, but honestly I doubt he's worried about variety in his closet [/size][size=1](especially after wearing the same outfit for years)[/size][size=2])[/size]
[*][b]NoNose option[/b] for the sprites, to truly match SCC
[*]Aaand [b]optional Nyapu-Style Portraits[/b]! So you can have both an adorable Eugene [i]and[/i] a Seasonal Eugene!
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Config[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal: Full, Vanilla, Original.[/b] Choose how many outfits you want him to have! 'Full' gives him one outfit per season + Spirit's Eve and Flower Dance, 'Vanilla' keeps his default outfit for Spring/Summer/Fall and adds a Winter outfit, and 'Original' is simply a portrait and sprite revamp without any new outfits
[*][b]Portrait Style: Auto, Vanilla, Nyapu.[/b] Choose your prefered portrait style, or leave it on 'Auto' so it chooses automatically depending on your mods!
[*][b]No Nose: true, false.[/b] To match SCC's NoNose option
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Mods in the Pictures[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugene[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url]﻿ + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754]1.6 fix[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿'s Overlays
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b][list]
[*]To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/irias0701]Leroy/irias0701[/url]﻿, of course! For creating Eugene in the first place and allowing these kinds of retextures of him! Also for the sprites base, as while the portraits were done from scratch (referencing the original design of course), the sprites were redrawn on top to make sure they didn't stray too far from the original silhouette!
[*]To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url]﻿﻿, for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]their adorable portraits[/url]﻿ and having open perms, which allowed me to include their portraits as an option for the seasonals!
[*]To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿, because even if I didn't use their assets directly, I did (try to) follow their Seasonal Cuter style, as it was the inspiration for this whole thing!
[/list][line]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=2]Did I have plans at some point to make the outfits look more diverse? Yes. Am I gonna do it? Not anytime soon. These have been sitting in my WIPs folder for months so I just wanted them out as soon as possible, sorry! In the future, perhaps. I hope you like them as they are right now, though <3[/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Eugene - Seasonal Outfits
Manifest.Description: Gives Eugene a sprite + portrait revamp with optional seasonal outfits, trying to fit him a bit better with Vanilla and SCC!
Manifest.Author: vikich3rry
